checks.name: 48_samples_to_odd_columns
checks.detail: 48 tubes -> 48 wells, odd columns only: True

checks.name: step_order
checks.detail: expected per well: beads > isopropanol > sample > remove > ethanol > remove > ethanol > remove > elution > recover

checks.name: fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact
checks.detail: 48 distinct tips for 48 sample transfers; violations: []

items.evidence: apiLevel 2.13; 540 µL removal is split into 3×180 µL and 500 µL ethanol into 3×167 µL, so nothing exceeds the 200 µL tips; the p1000 handles 250 µL and a 400 µL mix; the simulation passed and the reservoir check passed.

The p1000 uses a new tip for each of the 48 samples, and the multichannel takes a new tip per column for every removal and elution step. Every tip is dropped, and check fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact passed.

The step order, volumes (40/250/250, 2×500 µL ethanol, 100 µL elution) and times (5 min, 4 min, 4 min, 30 s, 90 s) match the paper, the temperature module is set to 4 °C, and all 17 run-log checks pass.
Checks 48_samples_to_odd_columns and distinct_elution_wells passed; each sample goes from its tube to its own odd-column well, and its eluate goes to the matching elution well.

The code adds beads, then isopropanol, then sample, followed by p1000.mix(5, ...), a 5 min delay, magdeck.engage() and a 4 min delay. It then removes the supernatant with the magnet on; checks binding_volumes_40_250_250 and magnet_4min_before_first_removal passed.

Two ethanol additions of 500 µL are each followed by remove_liquid(500) with the magnet engaged, then a 4 min delay with the magnet still on, then disengage before elution; checks two_500ul_ethanol_washes and air_dry_4min passed.

The magnet is disengaged, then 100 µL elution buffer is added and mixed 10×. After a 30 s delay the magnet is engaged for 90 s, and the eluate goes to its own well on the 4 °C plate; it recovers 100 µL rather than ~80 µL, which the 70–100 µL check accepts.

judge.summary: The protocol passes all 17 measured run-log checks and follows the paper's step order, volumes and timings, with fresh tips per sample and per column. The one soft deviation is that it recovers 100 µL of eluate instead of about 80 µL; the paper gives no recovery volume and the check accepts 70–100 µL, so I scored every item as a pass.
